# Lab 12.7: SSH to a VM with No External IP Using IAP

## What We Are Going to Do
Connect to a private VM over SSH and RDP-style port forwarding through IAP TCP forwarding, with no public IP and no bastion host.

## Steps

1. **Create a private VM.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create iap-ssh-vm \
  --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro --no-address</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Allow IAP's range on port 22.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-iap-ssh \
  --network=default --direction=INGRESS --action=ALLOW \
  --rules=tcp:22 --source-ranges=35.235.240.0/20</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Grant the IAP tunnel role** to the people who need it.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=user:alice@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/iap.tunnelResourceAccessor</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Alice also needs a way to log in to the VM, such as **Compute OS Admin Login** with OS Login (Lab 16.18).

4. **Connect.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh iap-ssh-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Forward any TCP port.** For example, reach a web server on port 80 at `localhost:8080`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute start-iap-tunnel iap-ssh-vm 80 \
  --local-host-port=localhost:8080 --zone=us-central1-a</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **See it in the logs.** In **Logs Explorer**, filter `protoPayload.serviceName="iap.googleapis.com"`. Each tunnel shows who connected and to which VM.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete iap-ssh-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute firewall-rules delete allow-iap-ssh --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| External IP | Not needed |
| Bastion host | Not needed |
| Source range | `35.235.240.0/20` only |
| Access control | IAM role `iap.tunnelResourceAccessor` |
